text: Itaque hoc a Jova decretum esse, illum ex lecto, in quem adscendisset, non esse descensurum, sed moriturum. \\p His ad nuntios ab Elia perlatis,
note: proofread: paragraph inside the verse at *Hīs ad nūntiōs ab Ēlīā perlātīs,*, the ablative absolute that opens 1738's own 1:5 and the KJV's ¶ at 1:5 moved to where Castellio's sentence begins (as r2's 5:19 and 1 Kgs 15:8); without it 1:1–12 run to 264 words, over 1 Kings' measure of about 250, now 1:1–4a 85 and 1:4b–12 179 (r1's alternative, 1:11 *At rēx iterum*, would leave a 54-word paragraph between the second and third captains); the angel's charge stays reported and unmarked as r1 set it; 1738 has no indent here (proofreader p1, 2026-11-23)
